source.location: Point-group TI root lists in main text and supplementary sections, with the per-row line references below

audit: For each row the source identifies a neutral monolayer E8 root of order two independently of the charge/CI/root extensions. The quotient is taken by that named physical root.

rows.name: Ci
rows.generator_description: Neutral monolayer E8 decoration on the inversion-related sigma blocks; doubling is a 3D E8 bubble.
rows.projection_meaning: Reference group / subgroup generated by the explicitly specified independent neutral E8 root
rows.comparison_limit: Abstract quotient comparison; does not supply a cochain embedding or identify each solver generator with a real-space block root.
